image-input.heading: Images
image-input.select: Select PNG, JPEG or WebP images
image-input.help: PNG, JPEG or WebP · Up to 8 images, 10 MiB each, 40 MiB total.
image-input.invalid: Choose valid still PNG, JPEG or WebP images. Animated or corrupt images are unavailable.
image-input.limits: Keep at most 8 images, each up to 10 MiB, with a combined size up to 40 MiB.
image-input.unsupported: This selection cannot receive images. Choose a supported Codex Agent Worker and Runner Device, or remove the images to send text.
image-input.update: Update the server and Runner Device to attach images. Text messages remain available.
image-input.transferFailed: Image transfer failed. Keep this draft and submit again to retry the original transfer.
image-input.cleanupFailed: Staged image cleanup could not be confirmed. Retry cleanup.
image-input.cleanupPending: Image cleanup is pending on the original Runner Device.
image-input.steerUnavailable: Steer is unavailable for image inputs. Queue delivery keeps the original images.
image-input.textLimit: The message exceeds 256 KiB. Keep the original draft and shorten the text.
image-input.creation-formats: Still PNG, JPEG or WebP only.
image-input.creation-limits: Up to 8 images per message, 10 MiB each, 40 MiB total.
image-input.creation-pixels: Up to 40 million pixels per image.
image-input.creation-requires: Requires a Codex Agent Worker with an image-capable model and a Runner Device that supports image inputs.
image-input.creation-unsupported: Claude Code, OpenCode and Grok Build image inputs are not supported in DeliDev.
image-input.generatedRunning: Native image generation is in progress.
image-input.generatedLimit: The original account reached its native image usage limit.
image-input.exportFailed: The image was not saved. Choose a new filename and try again.
image-input.exportUncertain: The save result is unknown. Check the original save before exporting again.
image-input.generatedUnsettled: The original native image call has no confirmed completion.
